messages:
maria: quick heads-up — opening a quota request for a new customer account in asia-south2, need p5 + g5 entitlement increases and some networking lifts. account: 123456789012
kevin: what are the exact numbers you're asking for (baseline vs burst)?
maria: baseline: 4 p5 instances, burst to 12 for onboarding spikes. g5 baseline: 8, burst to 24. peak concurrent GPUs ~36. justification: customerX dedicated serving pool for low-latency production models.
raj: network side — ENI and EIP numbers? subnet sizing?
maria: planning /24 per AZ for worker subnets. ENI estimate: additional 200 ENIs in region. EIPs: reserve 50 for NAT/egress fallback. will attach CIDR plan to the case.
sophie: please include an ops/business justification and projected throughput in the support ticket, helps expedite quota entitlements.
maria: created AWS support case: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home#/case/?caseId=CASE-12345 — added justification + perf profile. pasted snippet: ```Account: 123456789012
Region: ap-south-2 (asia-south2)
Resource requests: p5.48xlarge (baseline 4 / burst 12), g5.48xlarge (baseline 8 / burst 24)
Network: +200 ENIs, +50 EIPs, /24 subnets per AZ
Use case: dedicated inference for latency-sensitive models, production SLA 99.9%
Timeline: initial capacity required in 3 weeks for pilot rollout```
cloud-req-bot: Support case CASE-12345 created and tagged. Please add billing tag and network contact.
infra-oncall: note — we'll need a VPC peering route to eu-west-2 for logging before we finalize provisioning. I'll book a 30m window for cross-region networking changes.
jia: if AWS is slow, fallback plan: spin up smaller quantized model variants on our us-west-1 g5 pool to keep customers online. also consider model sharding to reduce p5 demand.
kevin: ballpark monthly cost impact? give me a rough committed vs on-demand delta.
maria: rough estimate: committed + expected on-demand bursts ~ $85k/month. will run exact numbers with finance once quota confirmed.
sophie: I'll assemble a quick spreadsheet with cost lines and attach to CASE-12345.
maria: assigning ownership to kevin to chase quota team and to raj to coordinate network CIDR/KMS access. tagging infra-ops. any other blockers?
raj: need KMS policy access confirmed for account 123456789012 and the subnet CIDR from neteng. once those are in the case, I can approve the ENI plan.
maria: thanks — pinging @sophie and @raj in the case. :thumbsup:
kevin: I'll follow up with AWS account team today and post updates here.
infra-oncall: logging the maintenance window: 3/28 02:00-02:30 UTC for peering config, will alert oncall and customers.
maria: great, closing loop for now. will update thread when CASE-12345 moves.
